canonical_project: Africell Data Centre at Tech and Innovation City, Tikonko (Bo District)
owner: Africell Sierra Leone; Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation
notes: Africell committed under MoU (Jun 2024) to build an ultra-modern data centre in the planned 130-acre Tech City Special Economic Zone in Tikonko chiefdom, Bo District, reportedly open to third parties; part of the US$150m Tech City project led by the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation. No construction/completion evidence found - status planned.
